rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD4 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1186](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1186/).
Information about the type of contact point for `ContactPointRelationship`s.
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.
Provides an IntegrityMethod with which the integrity of an Element can be asserted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.
Provides a License author's preferred text to indicate that a file is covered by the License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.
Property describes the invocation entrypoint of a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` ResolutionAction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` RequirementVerification.
typeFromSource is a value used to define an item within the definitionSource.
A code that identifies a county.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
Specifies the type of a content identifier.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such a social network of friends.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deviceDriver
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasExample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known to have been deployed and is in use. For a software as a service provider, this implies the software is now available as a service.
Specifies the time an artifact was built.
Timestamp, when an assessment was conducted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)
A software agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeletedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from` hasDeletedFile `to`).
Specifies the level of support associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.
Availability of dataset.
Specifies the version of a VEX statement.
The Agent who is responsible for product branding such as an OEM.
Identifies the download Uniform Resource Identifier for the package at the time that the document was created.
